title: Kernel selector v2 (runtime-1.19) — Rollout Checklist (Hosted + Dedicated)
content:
Doc purpose
- This is the step-by-step rollout checklist for Kernel selector v2 ("selector_v2") bundled with runtime-1.19.
- Audience: Release Engineering + SRE (oncall) + Runtime oncall.
- Scope: Hosted rollouts (regional + tiered), plus Dedicated opt-in.
- Non-goals: writing new kernels; changing API; fleet scheduler redesign.

Definitions / shorthand
- v1 selector: current heuristic selector (baseline)
- v2 selector: table-driven registry selector w/ rule fallback
- Safe kernel set: known-good kernels used for unknown model families / missing metadata
- "Enablement" = allow v2 to be chosen; "Default-on" = prefer v2 for eligible traffic
- Cohorts: internal canary -> 5% hosted -> 25% hosted -> dedicated opt-in -> default-on

Owners / escalation
- Release owner: Connor O’Brien
- SRE owner: Aisha Bello (primary), Allison Grant (backup)
- Runtime oncall: Omar El-Sayed
- Kernel selection: Grace Kim
- Telemetry/cardinality: Logan Wright / Thomas Baird (as needed)

Pre-flight prerequisites (must be true before any traffic shift)
[ ] Runtime version is cut and deployed to the target environment(s): runtime-1.19.x
    - Notes: Confirm the exact patch version in deploy UI + cluster runtime label.
[ ] Feature flag + kill switch are present and validated in staging
    - Confirm config keys exist (names vary by environment):
      - selector.enable_v2 (or selector.v2_enabled)
      - selector.v2_default_on
      - selector.v2_kill_switch (hard disable)
      - selector.v2_overrides (per model-family / GPU / seq bucket)
    - Confirm precedence order (expected): kill switch > explicit override > default-on flag > enablement gate > v1 fallback
[ ] Kernel registry loads successfully on all target GPU pools
    - No startup failures / registry parse errors
    - Registry version pinned (record exact registry version / hash in rollout notes)
[ ] Unknown model family behavior verified
    - For unknown/partial model metadata, selector must route to safe kernel set, not crash.
[ ] Conformance tests green for top model families and representative shapes
    - Includes NaN/overflow checks, shape mismatch guards
[ ] Perf-canary gate is enabled for selector_v2 experiments
    - CI / benchmark-lab artifacts linked and accessible to Release + SRE
[ ] Telemetry is shipping and cardinality is within the agreed budget
    - Metric labels are bucketed (no raw seq lengths; no request ids)
    - Sampling configured for trace annotations (avoid trace explosion)

Required dashboards (open before enabling canary)
Primary SLO & health
[ ] Runtime SLO dashboard (p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, saturation) by region + tier
[ ] Token throughput (tok/s) by GPU SKU and model family
[ ] Retries/timeouts (client + internal) and queueing time
[ ] GPU utilization + memory pressure + OOM rate

Selector-specific dashboards
[ ] Selector version breakdown: v1 vs v2 share over time (by region, GPU SKU)
[ ] Kernel-choice heatmap: kernel_id x GPU SKU x seq bucket
[ ] Fallback counters:
    - v2->v1 fallback rate
    - unknown model family -> safe kernel set rate
    - registry-miss / rule-fallback rate
[ ] Correctness indicators:
    - NaN detected counter (if enabled)
    - output validation failures (conformance guardrails)
    - kernel execution error rate (CUDA errors, illegal memory access)

Acceptance thresholds (rollout guardrails)
- General: Any sustained user-visible regression => stop rollout / rollback.
- For canary cohorts, evaluate at least one peak window (>= 60–90 min) and one low-traffic window (>= 30 min) unless otherwise approved by SRE.

Hard rollback triggers (immediate)
[ ] Error rate increase above SLO guardrail (per SRE doc), sustained > 5 minutes
[ ] Any correctness signal (NaN/invalid outputs) above baseline + confirmed correlated with selector_v2
[ ] Crash loop or kernel execution errors (CUDA illegal access / persistent kernel failure)
[ ] Unexpected traffic shift causing overload (queue time spikes + GPU saturation) attributable to kernel choice

Soft rollback triggers (pause + investigate; rollback if not resolved quickly)
[ ] p95 latency regression > agreed budget on any major GPU SKU (L4/A10/A100/H100) for > 15 minutes
[ ] p95 tail variance increases materially (e.g., p95/p50 ratio worsens) with no offsetting throughput gains
[ ] Regression isolated to a single model family / seq bucket and can be mitigated with override
[ ] Telemetry cardinality / metrics ingestion issues caused by selector labels

Rollout stages (Hosted)
Stage 0 — Internal canary (employees / dogfood)
Goal: validate basics (telemetry, selection distribution, no correctness issues)
[ ] Confirm flag state in internal env: enable_v2=on, v2_default_on=off (initially)
[ ] Run targeted smoke tests:
    - Short prompt (prefill-dominant)
    - Long prompt (prefill heavy)
    - Sustained decode (long generation)
[ ] Confirm selector explain/debug output works (for at least 3 contexts)
    - Capture examples in rollout notes: (model family, GPU, seq bucket) -> kernel_id and decision path
[ ] Confirm no increase in:
    - server errors
    - CUDA/kernels errors
    - NaN/invalid output counters

Stage 1 — Hosted 5% canary (single region to start)
Recommended initial: us-east (or current designated canary region)
[ ] Set config:
    - enable_v2=on
    - v2_default_on=on for cohort=5% (or route-based %)
    - kill_switch=off
[ ] Record cohort definition (how % is computed): by org_id hash / request hash / cluster shard
[ ] Monitor for 60–90 minutes:
    - p95 latency by GPU SKU
    - error rate + timeouts
    - fallback rates
    - kernel-choice drift (unexpected kernel_id spikes)
[ ] If regression isolated:
    - Apply temporary override for (model family, GPU SKU, seq bucket)
    - Re-evaluate metrics for >= 30 minutes
[ ] Decision gate (sign-off): Runtime oncall + SRE
    - Proceed / pause / rollback

Stage 2 — Hosted 25% (expand within same region first, then add 1–2 regions)
[ ] Increase cohort to 25% in canary region
[ ] After stable for >= 2 hours, add one additional region
[ ] Confirm no region-specific anomalies (capacity differences, GPU SKU mix)
[ ] Validate selection distribution remains consistent w/ registry expectations

Stage 3 — Hosted 50% (optional, based on risk)
[ ] Only if we have had at least one full day with 25% across 2+ regions with no major issues
[ ] Increase to 50% in two highest-traffic regions
[ ] Re-check tail lat and queue time during peak

Stage 4 — Hosted default-on (100%)
[ ] Set v2_default_on=on for all eligible traffic
[ ] Keep enable_v2=on; keep kill switch ready
[ ] Confirm v1 fallback remains functional (do NOT remove v1 path in this release)
[ ] Post-change verification (first 2 hours):
    - v2 share is ~expected (some requests may remain v1 due to compatibility)
    - unknown model family traffic routes to safe kernel set
    - no new kernel execution errors

Dedicated rollout (opt-in)
Goal: allow specific Dedicated customers/clusters to enable v2 with tight monitoring.
[ ] Confirm Dedicated cluster has runtime-1.19.x and correct GPU SKU normalization
[ ] Pre-customer checklist:
    - Customer approval for potential perf variability during eval window
    - Rollback plan communicated (how to revert quickly)
    - Identify customer’s top model families + seq length distribution
[ ] Enable v2 on a single Dedicated cluster (or a subset of pool) first
[ ] Monitor cluster-local dashboards (same metrics as Hosted; additionally per-customer error budget)
[ ] If customer requests pinning:
    - Use per-model-family override rather than disabling globally
    - Document the exact override (who/when/why)

Operational notes: how to rollback
Preferred rollback path (fastest)
1) Flip kill switch ON (forces v1 selector everywhere; maintains deterministic behavior)
2) Optionally set v2_default_on=off (keeps enablement for debug if kill switch is later removed)
3) Confirm within 5–10 minutes:
   - selector version breakdown returns to v1
   - latency and error signals stabilize
   - fallback counters normalize

Alternative rollback/mitigation (targeted)
- If only one model family or GPU SKU is problematic:
  - Add override: (model family, seq bucket, GPU SKU) -> kernel_id (known-good) OR force v1 for that slice
  - Keep v2 enabled for the rest of traffic

Post-rollback tasks (required)
[ ] Create incident or release note entry (even if no customer impact) with:
    - timeline
    - affected slices (GPU SKU / model family / seq bucket)
    - dashboard screenshots/links
    - mitigation applied
[ ] File follow-up tickets (Linear) for:
    - missing registry entries
    - bucket boundary bugs
    - GPU normalization issues
    - telemetry/cardinality adjustments

Communication checklist
[ ] Slack: announce start of rollout in #eng-releases and #eng-runtime with links to dashboards + this doc
[ ] During canary: post updates at each gate (5% start, 5% stable, 25% start, etc.)
[ ] If rollback: post immediate note + reason + next steps; tag Runtime oncall + SRE oncall
[ ] After default-on: post final summary + perf delta + any outstanding follow-ups

What to capture in rollout notes (copy/paste template)
- Runtime version:
- Registry version/hash:
- Flag states (enable_v2, v2_default_on, kill_switch):
- Cohort definition (% + hashing key):
- Regions included:
- GPUs observed (mix):
- Model families observed (top 5 by traffic):
- Perf deltas vs baseline (p50/p95, tok/s):
- Any overrides applied:
- Any anomalies + links to dashboards:
- Sign-offs (names + time):

Appendix: quick sanity checks (common failure modes)
- v2 share = 0% even when enabled
  - Likely: flag not applied to the right tier/region; config not picked up; eligibility gating too strict.
- v2 share = 100% including unsupported models
  - Likely: missing compatibility checks; unknown family not routed to safe set.
- Sudden spike in kernel_id cardinality
  - Likely: unbucketed seq length; kernel_id includes dynamic suffix; missing label allowlist.
- Long-context p95 regression only on A10
  - Likely: wrong seq bucket boundary; A10-specific kernel choice; override to known-good and open ticket.

Change log
- 2026-01-28: initial draft (Connor)
- 2026-02-03: added dashboards + triggers aligned w/ SRE guardrails (Aisha)
- 2026-02-12: added dedicated opt-in + override guidance (Benji/Omar)
- 2026-02-18: tightened rollback language and added capture template (Allison/Connor)
